title: Filtering issues and pull requests by labels

steps.quote: On GitHub, navigate to the main page of the repository.
steps.text: On GitHub, navigate to the main page of the repository.
steps.goal: The repository's main page is open
steps.skip_reason: Covered by the start URL (the repository's main page).

steps.quote: Under your repository name, click **Issues** or **Pull requests**.
steps.text: Under your repository name, click Issues or Pull requests.
steps.goal: The repository's list of issues is visible

steps.quote: Above the list of issues or pull requests, click **Labels**.
steps.text: Above the list of issues or pull requests, click Labels.
steps.goal: The repository's list of labels is visible

steps.quote: In the list of labels, click a label.
steps.text: In the list of labels, click a label.
steps.goal: A list of issues filtered by one label is visible
steps.skip_reason: Names no specific label to follow.
